mentions.name: Surfing Game
mentions.description: This is a surfing game in development with Unity that aims to stay close to the real sport, focusing on realistic mechanics such as pumping, carving, and nose-riding. A playable demo is planned as the next step.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on a surfing game on my spare time for the past year. The idea is to keep it closer to the real sport, focusing on pumping, carving, nose-riding, etc.
